technical.summary: GILD shows solid long-term bullish structure with price above key EMAs and MACD crossover, but weak trend strength (ADX 21), overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), and conflicting short-term momentum signals limit swing entry conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (185.6) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 80 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.
